component.name: 1IPTV
component.summary: Modern IPTV player for M3U playlists and Xtream Codes with hardware-accelerated libmpv

description.p: 1IPTV is a fast, modern desktop IPTV player designed for your personal M3U/M3U8 playlists and Xtream Codes services, powered by hardware-accelerated libmpv playback.

ul.li: Multi-Provider Support: Connect Xtream Codes accounts, remote M3U/M3U8 URLs, and local M3U files.
Hardware-Accelerated libmpv Engine: Smooth 4K, HEVC, H.264, and HLS/MPEG-TS playback with audio/subtitle track switching and multi-monitor fullscreen.
Live TV & EPG: Interactive Electronic Program Guide, inline live preview, fast channel zapping, and catch-up TV support.
Movies & Series (VOD): Rich catalog browsing with TMDB metadata, ratings, trailers, episode tracking, and resume playback.
Online Subtitles (OpenSubtitles): Search and download subtitles inside the player with adjustable subtitle delay.
Offline Downloads & Live Recording: Save VOD movies/episodes offline and record live TV streams to disk.
Organization & Search: Instant global search, custom playlist and channel reordering, favorites, and watch history.
Cloud Backup & Parental Controls: PIN-protected lock and Google Drive backup/restore for providers, favorites, and settings.
19+ Languages: Full localization including English, Arabic (RTL), French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, and more.

description.p: Note: 1IPTV is a media player application only. No channels, playlists, media streams, or credentials are bundled with the application.
Linux desktop release with hardware-accelerated libmpv playback and multi-monitor fullscreen support.
